summary: Customer requested a new Site Scanner tenant/instance for the HCHB business with IDP domains and admin users.
mechanism: Onboarding request; new tenant with licenses (WEB_FLOW_ANALYZER, WEB_SDK, SCANNER), IDP domains in Auth0 and admin users needed.
resolution: Support created the tenant, support account, licenses and admin users.

summary: User exported a report but never received the export email(s).
mechanism: Export email was sent and accepted by the customer's mail server but quarantined by the customer's Barracuda email gateway.
resolution: Support confirmed delivery in email system; customer released files from Barracuda quarantine.
log_signals: export email sent / accepted by recipient MX (email provider delivery log)

summary: Asked support to copy a Sandbox property (cookie consent modal setup) to Prod; then cancelled and did it themselves.
mechanism: Request to duplicate property config between tenants/environments; no product problem.
resolution: Customer cancelled and created the property themselves.

summary: Question on how Site Scanner crawls - sitemap vs following links from configured pages.
mechanism: How-to / product behavior question to maximize coverage.
resolution: Answered in Slack.

summary: Support proactively asked to prune unneeded properties (139) and adjust weekly scheduling; one property always 0 pages due to login.
mechanism: Tenant load management: many properties on weekly schedule, some stale/login-gated (0 pages).
resolution: Agreed to keep properties, exclude store.delish.com from scheduling, and move stable 5k-page properties to less frequent schedules.
gt_class_doubt: Mentions a login-gated property consistently returning 0 pages (class 2 symptom) but ticket is account housekeeping.

summary: Customer reported Image-alt false positives on 0px analytics web-beacon images (demdex.net).
mechanism: Not a false positive: 0px images can still be announced by screen readers; need alt="" or role=presentation.
resolution: Explained the violation is legitimate; Jira closed.

summary: Customer security team (Fortify DAST exclusion) asked which Evinced URLs to list for prod/non-prod.
mechanism: Customer-side security allowlisting paperwork needed Evinced service domains.
resolution: Confirmed hub.evinced.com and auth.evinced.com for both environments.

summary: Asked for enforced naming convention for WFA session names and whether report links are guessable.
mechanism: Session name is free-form; no templating. Report links use unguessable scan/session IDs.
resolution: Added to existing feature request; explained links are GUID-based.

summary: Customer asked to apply the same custom two-screen login configuration from an existing property to a new property.
mechanism: Custom multi-step authentication requires support-side configuration per property; not self-serve.
resolution: Support copied the custom auth configuration to the new property (CS-2148).

summary: Locked text spacing issue stopped being reported though CSS (!important letter/word-spacing) was unchanged; customer asked if it had been an FP.
mechanism: Validation algorithm updated; prior detections were confirmed false positives (rule placement in CSS hierarchy does not functionally lock spacing) and fixed in engine update.
resolution: Explained engine FP fix; customer asked for proactive FP communication.
ui_signals: Locked text spacing issue disappeared between scans

summary: CSV export contains more rows/issue count than shown in Site Scanner issues page.
mechanism: CSV rows are HTML elements (issue x component/selector) while UI counts issues; one issue may span multiple elements.
resolution: Explained; customer requested better documentation.
ui_signals: CSV issue count higher than UI issue count

summary: 'Error Loading Scan' frequently when clicking the 'Needs Review' wedge of the Breakdown by Severity pie chart on any scan.
mechanism: Not reproducible by support; occurred only in customer's Chrome, worked in Edge - likely browser/client-side (extension/cache) issue.
resolution: Customer switched to Edge; closed without root cause.
ui_signals: Needs Review wedge click on overview pie chart

summary: After SSO migration, users were prompted to log in when opening ephemeral screenshot links from CSV export.
mechanism: Unknown; suspected Auth0 mapping/SSO config; engineering could not reproduce and asked for HAR. Customer later reported no issue.
resolution: Investigated via CS-2193/EW-11346; customer could not reproduce; closed.
ui_signals: login prompt when opening screenshot link from CSV export

summary: Issues sorted incorrectly by custom severities in Site Scanner.
mechanism: UI/backend sorting did not respect custom severity name mapping.
resolution: Developers released a fix (CS-1421).
ui_signals: incorrect sort order with custom severities

summary: Excel export of a 100-page scan (~4,300 issues) repeatedly failed with 'There was a problem creating your export'; filtered export (critical, ~1,400) worked.
mechanism: Backend global limit of 10,000 rows in Excel export; rows are unique issue x component/selector combinations so 4,291 issues exceeded 10k rows. No UI warning of the limit.
resolution: Explained limit; workaround = filter in UI or use CSV export; fix targeted (CS-2413) but customer closed after 4 months.
log_signals: export failure for tenant (searched Coralogix by tenant id / user email - nothing found initially)
ui_signals: There was a problem creating your export (email)

summary: WFA user could not open previous sessions for comparison; clicking older sessions did nothing; delete didn't work.
mechanism: Bug in Web Flow Analyzer session list/loading with many sessions (146 sessions, 2.75MB of 10MB storage).
resolution: Fix released in WFA version 1.2.97 (CS-2319).
gt_class_doubt: WFA (Web Flow Analyzer) issue, not Site Scanner.

summary: Users could log in to platform.evinced.com but lacked the 'upload to platform' option in WFA.
mechanism: Platform/upload access was enabled per-individual user, not tenant-wide; one user had no account yet (installed WFA in wrong browser); users needed full logout/login to refresh permissions.
resolution: Support enabled platform access per user; users re-logged in.
ui_signals: Platform upload option missing in WFA

summary: Weekly Sunday schedule showed next scan on 12/27-28 instead of 12/21.
mechanism: Backend bug: properties API returned wrong nextScheduleJobTime (28th instead of 21st); UI localizes time causing the 27th display.
resolution: Backend bug fixed (CS-2318).
ui_signals: Next scan date wrong in property scheduling

summary: Duplicate of #1378: scheduled weekly scan did not run Sunday; next scheduled date shown as Dec 28.
mechanism: Same as #1378 - wrong nextScheduleJobTime from backend.
resolution: Solved during office hours (bug fix via CS-2318).
gt_class_doubt: Possibly a missed scheduled run (scheduler) - could be class 1-ish scheduler_missed_run.

summary: Customer's security saw repeated failed logins (wrong password) for the scanning account from Evinced IPs, causing account/IP blocking.
mechanism: Wrong password configured in one property's login form; plus product bug: editing login-form credentials updates only the scanner config, NOT the crawler, so crawler kept using old password (also caused low crawl page count). One static NAT IP got blocked by customer.
resolution: Fixed password, removed properties from blocked static IP, manually updated crawler creds in DB; Jira to be opened for scanner/crawler credential sync.
log_signals: wrong password login failures in crawler logs (Coralogix query by tenant)
ui_signals: customer-side: failed logins from Evinced IP
gt_class_doubt: Effects include low crawl page count / login failure - arguably class 1/4.

summary: Customer wanted to schedule a single one-off scan.
mechanism: Believed unsupported; actually 'Scan now' exists on property page (and monthly-schedule-then-disable workaround).
resolution: Pointed to 'Scan now' button; FR CS-2327 closed.

summary: Score spikes on Habitat/Tu Clothing; customer called issues on 404/500 pages 'false positives' and crawler issues.
mechanism: Listed URLs redirected (site server errors / removed products) to 500/404 pages; scanner follows redirects and scans the error page, producing issues on unlisted pages and skewing scores.
resolution: Explained not FPs; suggested removing stale URLs / excluding error page paths; feature request to skip pages when not landing on expected URL.
ui_signals: Internal Error / Page not found pages in scanned pages list

summary: Property settings page rendered blank for an admin user.
mechanism: Backend/UI bug, found and fixed by engineering (EW-13119).
resolution: Fixed on backend; customer confirmed.

summary: CSV download from All Issues has duplicate issues inflating count nearly 2x vs report.
mechanism: Export rows are per issue x component/selector; same Issue ID repeats; expected behavior.
resolution: Explained, showed Excel dedupe on Issue ID to match platform count.
ui_signals: duplicate Issue IDs in CSV export

summary: Needed help scoping a property to only /client-portal pages.
mechanism: 'Include domain' made crawler cover the whole domain; needed seed URL + include regex only.
resolution: Removed include domain, used seed and include regex ^https?://myersandstauffer.com/client-portal.*
gt_class_doubt: Crawl scope (wrong URLs) - could be class 4.

summary: Azure DevOps 'Create' in Site Scanner did nothing; other users got 401/CORS errors connecting to ADO.
mechanism: ADO rejected work item create: TF401322 bypass rules permission (WorkItemUnauthorizedRuleBypassException) because Evinced used bypassRules; other users blocked by org OAuth policy/CORS 401; later admin consent required due to broad OAuth scopes.
resolution: Engineering added toggle to respect ADO rules (WFA first, then Site Scanner) and reduced OAuth scopes to vso.profile, vso.project, vso.work, vso.graph (CS-2426); admin consent still needed on customer side.
log_signals: TF401322: You don't have bypass rules permission
Access to fetch at 'https://dev.azure.com/.../_apis/projects?api-version=6.0' blocked by CORS policy
ui_signals: Create button does nothing, modal stays open

summary: Scans behind login (list mode) always failed for sky.de.
mechanism: Login page redirects non-DE/AT IPs to out-of-country page, so login selectors are absent.
resolution: Suggested adding redirect URL/crawl mode with exclude regex, or customer whitelisting Evinced static NAT IPs and configuring static IPs for property.
log_signals: encountered error while running a function with timeout. retry count: 0
gt_class_doubt: Scan failure due to login - really class 1 or 2.

summary: Nested Interactive issue flagged on jQuery UI Tabs; recommended fix did not clear it.
mechanism: True positive caused by jQuery UI Tabs markup (known jQuery UI issue); requires role=none presentation plus removing href via JS.
resolution: Guidance given, pointed to jQuery UI PR; no product change.
gt_class_doubt: Found via WFA; not Site Scanner specific.

summary: Big jump in issues on logged-out property; suspected crawl problem.
mechanism: A listed URL redirected to the site's /500 page from Jun 2025 to Feb 2026; once fixed, real page was scanned and its issues appeared as 'new'.
resolution: Explained via URL status page; recommended reviewing pages list/redirects each scan; FR submitted.
ui_signals: issue count jump in scan comparison

summary: CSV export zip download broken when property name contains '&'.
mechanism: Special characters in property name break export file name/extension.
resolution: Customer renamed download to .zip; flagged to engineering.
ui_signals: Accessibility issue list is ready email; downloaded file without .zip extension

summary: 30 pages reported page-has-heading-one though they have <h1>.
mechanism: One scan run flagged an existing h1 (likely timing/page state at scan time); later scans correct. Best practice rule, no score impact.
resolution: Explained transient FP and no score impact; asked about deployments.

summary: Huge increase in Language attribute mismatch issues from /es-US/ URLs on sites without Spanish content.
mechanism: Customer Sitecore/Next.js rewrite rules exposed es-US locale paths across domains; crawler discovered them. Stopped after customer deployments.
resolution: Suggested excluding es-US; engineering added page hierarchy trace (CS-2415).
gt_class_doubt: Crawl discovering unexpected URLs - class 4 candidate.

summary: Needed property to scan only /patient path, not whole site.
mechanism: New property auto-adds domain to seed list; needed include regex limiting to /patient.
resolution: Provided regex ^https?://.*cortisolmatters.com(/patient.*)?$

summary: Very large 'Needs review' color contrast counts (gradients) suspected FPs.
mechanism: axe 'Needs review' contrast results where gradient prevents automatic determination; manual check passes WCAG 1.4.3.
resolution: Disabled Needs Review and Best Practice for natwest.com property (CS-2457); tenant-level adjustment planned.

summary: After custom severity names (High/Medium/Low), Breakdown by Components and later Quick Win Suggestions stopped showing.
mechanism: Features hardcoded to default Critical bucket; not custom-severity-aware (QuickWin.tsx criticalIssuesPercentage threshold).
resolution: Fixed component breakdown (CS-2417) and quick wins (CS-2649).
ui_signals: We don't have enough data for this section.

summary: Need to filter out WCAG 2.2 AA results in Site Scanner like WFA regulation filter.
mechanism: Site Scanner only has Level filter; regulation filter not yet implemented.
resolution: On roadmap.

summary: Asked if Target Size violations qualify for WCAG inline exception.
mechanism: Standalone link items not inline in sentences; true positive.
resolution: Explained.

summary: Questioned color contrast flag on 20px text.
mechanism: Customer used wrong color (#000 vs actual #232323); 20px non-bold is regular text; 4.31:1 < 4.5:1, true positive.
resolution: Explained.

summary: Could not set public/private when creating property.
mechanism: Public/private is at collection level via Manage Collections.
resolution: Explained.

summary: Scanner 'stops at 45 and never finished' on CTL property.
mechanism: Property set to List Mode with only 1 URL, so crawl did nothing beyond it.
resolution: Suggested switching to Crawl mode with seed URL and domain.
gt_class_doubt: Really a crawl/scan failure or low page count (class 1/4).

summary: Pages data table export missing Issue columns.
mechanism: Export bug omitting issue columns.
resolution: Fixed by engineering (CS-2446).
ui_signals: exported page table missing issue columns

summary: Customer wanted to reset Site Scanner score.
mechanism: Score computed from scan history; can't be reset.
resolution: Explained baseline approach; data retention 1 year.

summary: Wants date-range export and scan load chart.
mechanism: Not supported.
resolution: Feature request filed.

summary: Add to Jira didn't accept on-prem Jira host.
mechanism: Jira Server/DC requires application link config + client credentials provided to Evinced.
resolution: Customer declined IT work.

summary: Suggested new validation for role=alert/status on form errors.
mechanism: Not supported.
resolution: Feature request filed.

summary: Error loading scan sporadically when opening issue types.
mechanism: Backend outage.
resolution: Fix released.
